Just days before Christmas, Solaris Vocal Ensemble invites you to pause from the holiday hustle and celebrate the season with music that shines. Featuring the beautiful and expressive sounds of harpist Rebecca Kauffman performing alongside Solaris, Season of Light brings together joyful seasonal favorites and music that invites us to reflect on the deeper meaning of the season. At the heart of the concert is Taylor Scott Davis’s captivating Journey Into Light Christmas Suite, surrounded by stirring and luminous works by Anna Lapwood, Stephen Paulus,…

listings.title: Winter Solstice Cosmic Sound Journey
listings.venue: The Sanctuary for Healing and Liberation
listings.description: Marking the Winter Solstice, the Cosmic Sound Journey is a two-hour sound and meditation experience that invites us to meet ourselves exactly as we are. The power and transcendental energies of large planetary gongs in a full-body listening experience, accompanied by Tibetan bowls, crystal bowls, and other instruments creates deep vibrations and layered soundscapes designed for presence and release.
